editorial_identity: The Economist, reimagined as a Chicago-based local newspaper. Analytical, globally-minded, data-literate. Transformative AI is the defining story of our era — give it the editorial weight The Economist gave globalisation or China's rise. Articles 5-6 are always from the sports desk: Article 5 covers Chicago & Michigan, Article 6 is the Arsenal beat.

topics.label: Transformative AI
topics.selection_note: The lead beat. AI model releases, capability milestones, regulation, economic impact, safety, workforce effects. Not 'tech' broadly — the AI transformation story specifically. Should appear in most issues.

topics.label: Economics & Finance
topics.selection_note: The Economist's finance & economics section. Central bank decisions, trade policy, fiscal policy, macro indicators, emerging market developments, labour markets.

topics.label: International Affairs
topics.selection_note: Geopolitics, diplomacy, conflicts, elections abroad, institutional developments. Stories a well-informed Chicagoan should know about.

topics.label: US Governance & Policy
topics.selection_note: Consequential executive actions, legislative votes, court rulings, agency decisions. Analytical, not horse-race. Include Illinois state politics when significant.

topics.label: Chicago & Illinois
topics.selection_note: City council, transit, infrastructure, public safety, economic development. What a thoughtful Chicagoan needs to know about their city.

topics.label: Business & Industry
topics.selection_note: Corporate strategy, M&A, market structure, industry disruption, antitrust. Not earnings reports — stories that reveal how industries are changing.

topics.label: Sports Desk — Chicago & Michigan
topics.selection_note: Article 5 is ALWAYS a Chicago/Michigan sports story. Chicago Cubs, Bulls, or Bears — whichever is in season. Michigan football (Sep–Jan) or basketball (Nov–Apr). Pick the most compelling story of the day.

topics.label: Sports Desk — Arsenal Beat
topics.selection_note: Article 6 is ALWAYS an Arsenal football story. Premier League matches, transfers, manager decisions, youth academy, European competition. Always introduced as the Arsenal beat (兵工廠線).

topics.label: Science, Technology & Ideas
topics.selection_note: The Economist's back pages. Breakthroughs, research with policy implications, ideas that reframe thinking. Good for serendipity picks.

selection_note: Pick 6 stories total. Articles 1-4 are the Economist desk (AI, economics, world, policy, chicago, business, ideas — aim for variety, don't force every category). Articles 5-6 are always sports: Article 5 is Chicago/Michigan, Article 6 is Arsenal. Lead with whatever is genuinely most interesting today — AI stories should appear frequently but don't need to lead every issue. The newspaper should feel like flipping through a smart, cosmopolitan local paper, not a hyper-targeted feed.
